contentText:
Jaguar's all-electric Type 01 comes with a very beige interior that divides the four seats with a "spine" that spans the length of the cabin. New photos shared by Jaguar show a low-slung driver's seat, alongside a slim dashboard with a smartphone-style display in the center.

This vehicle doesn't come with a traditional rear-view mirror, as Jaguar says you'll find a "ClearSight Rear View Display" at the very bottom of the windshield, positioned at the "same height as the door mirrors, to help the driver focus."
